description: Expected name keys. The key is the name in NFC, folded with the Unicode 17.0 simple case folding (CaseFolding.txt, statuses C and S), then in NFC again.

vectors.name: decomposed
vectors.description: A letter plus a combining accent composes to the same key as the precomposed form.

vectors.name: sharp-s
vectors.description: Simple folding keeps the sharp s; it does not become 'ss'.

vectors.name: capital-sharp-s
vectors.description: The capital sharp s folds to the small sharp s.

vectors.name: greek-final-sigma
vectors.description: The final sigma folds to the ordinary sigma.

vectors.name: greek-capitals
vectors.description: Capital Greek gives the same key as the mixed-case name above.

vectors.name: dotted-capital-i
vectors.description: The dotted capital I has only Turkish and full foldings, so simple folding leaves it unchanged.

vectors.name: kelvin-sign
vectors.description: The Kelvin sign folds to a plain k.

vectors.name: angstrom-sign
vectors.description: The Angstrom sign becomes A with ring in NFC, then folds to a with ring.

vectors.name: cherokee
vectors.description: Cherokee small letters fold to the capital letters.

vectors.name: supplementary-plane
vectors.description: Deseret capitals outside the Basic Multilingual Plane fold to their small letters.

vectors.name: emoji
vectors.description: An emoji is left as it is.

vectors.name: fullwidth
vectors.description: Fullwidth capitals fold to fullwidth small letters.

vectors.name: hangul-jamo
vectors.description: Decomposed Hangul jamo compose to one syllable.

vectors.name: spaces-and-dots
vectors.description: Spaces and dots are kept; name validation decides whether they are allowed.
